text:
Type: open-weave bamboo basket
Use: storing throws, magazines, toys or a plant pot; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, coastal
Materials: wide strips of split bamboo in a natural finish, bound rim
Colors: light natural bamboo, pale honey
Shape: round tub that tapers slightly toward the base, large open checkerboard weave with square gaps, wrapped double rim, low and wide, light and airy
Feel: natural, relaxed, warm
Goes with: linen, green plants, light wood, white walls; bohemian, coastal or Japandi rooms

product.name: GADDIS
product.description: Each basket is woven by hand and is therefore unique.
